verdict.rationale: Yubico documents a broad set of official first-party SDKs: the .NET YubiKey SDK, YubiKit for Android and iOS, python-fido2, and java-webauthn-server. A runtime probe confirms python-fido2 resolves on PyPI as fido2 2.2.1. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Yubico has developed a range of mobile SDKs, such as for iOS and Android, and also desktop SDKs to enable developers to rapidly integrate hardware security into their apps
The SDK allows you to integrate the YubiKey and its applications into your .NET-based application or library.
YubiKit is an Android library provided by Yubico to enable YubiKey support in Android apps.
Provides library functionality for communicating with a FIDO device over USB as well as verifying attestation and assertion signatures.
Yubico's python-fido2 SDK resolves on the public PyPI registry (fido2 2.2.1)
